findings.title: Misjudged craft arrives without weight
findings.claim: The pericope lets the focus's weightless deeds be heard as substantial effort and apparently good craft that have been reckoned by a failing private measure.
findings.mechanism: The greatest losers, lost striving, self-supposed excellence, making, religious denial, valuation, and weighing meet at the focus: work is produced and judged, but the self-assessment does not establish its standing in the final measure.
findings.reader_payoff: The verdict can be perceived as a failure of valuation and direction within an active portfolio of work, not merely as a statement that no effort existed.
findings.containment: The ordinary claim that deeds are nullified and receive no weight remains intact; the craft and accounting imagery is a pericope-grounded resonance and does not replace the judgment.

epistemic.reason: A trusted channel nomination is anchored in the supplied 18:103-105 sequence, and each nominated branch has a supplied branch record and an independent contextual or focus trigger.

findings.title: Weight touches alignment
findings.claim: The focus's establishment of weight also touches an alignment axis because the immediately preceding striving has lost its course: the measure can be heard as asking whether work remains straight and balanced as well as whether it is present.
findings.mechanism: The focus q-w-m occurrence carries an accepted straightness-and-balance branch, while 18:104 supplies the independent lost-course and striving occurrences and a direct connection identifying that misdirection before the focus verdict.
findings.reader_payoff: No weight becomes newly perceptible as a failure of right placement or direction alongside the ordinary evaluative judgment.
findings.containment: This is a single uncandidate contextual activation of the focus q-w-m branch. It does not replace the value/appraisal reading, import the external Fātiḥa overlay, or claim that every kind of misdirection is being measured here.

epistemic.reason: The accepted focus branch, exact context roots, and strong authored connection support the contact, but the activation is an authorial discovery rather than a supplied candidate.
